title: Robert Irwin's 5 Words to Live By | #NatGeo9

author: National Geographic
description:
Robert Irwin - conservationist, wildlife photographer, and host of "Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro" - joins National Geographic in the yellow chair to answer the Nat Geo 9. Find out what advice Robert would tell his nine-year-old self, five words he lives by, and the one person who has had the most impact on his life.

Be sure to watch "Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro," premiering tonight at 8/7c on ABC. Stream next day on Disney+ and Hulu.
